name: How long does it take to paint a garage?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to paint a garage varies based on its size, the scope of work (walls, ceiling, floor), and necessary preparation. Typically, painting the walls and ceiling of a standard two-car garage can take 1-3 days, including prep work like cleaning, patching, and priming. If a garage floor coating is applied, additional time is needed for proper curing, which can be 24-72 hours before light foot traffic and several days to a week before vehicle parking. Professional teams can often complete projects more efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting a standard two-car garage typically takes 1-3 days for walls and ceiling, plus additional time for floor coating curing.
